title: SlashStringFolia
body:
A Paper & Folia 1.21.1 version inspired by SlashString.

Based on:
* https://github.com/StinkyCheeseKid/SlashString
* https://modrinth.com/plugin/slash-string

Commands:
* /**string** - Gives the player a full inventory of string. If the inventory is full, the remaining string is dropped on the ground.
* /**stringfolia reload** - Reloads the **config.yml**.

**@infectedware on discord for bugs.**
